The composer died in 1908. This assessment does not cover a later edition or arrangement.

Rule 1 — CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication stated for this recording file Documented

Commons explicitly supplies CC0 for this sound file; this is the programme’s recording-licence route, not a composition-only tag or an age-based clearance. The uploader’s chain of title is not independently established.
